apihelp-query+compass-example: Show all wikis on the form.
apihelp-query+compass-param-category: Filter by the CreateWiki defined category of a wiki.
apihelp-query+compass-param-customurl: Filter by if the wiki has a CreateWiki defined custom URL.
apihelp-query+compass-param-language: Filter by the CreateWiki defined language code of a wiki.
apihelp-query+compass-param-limit: Maximum number of results to show.
apihelp-query+compass-param-prop: Information to return about a defined wiki.
apihelp-query+compass-param-state: Filter by the CreateWiki defined state of a wiki.
apihelp-query+compass-param-wikis: Get a list of specific wikis.
apihelp-query+compass-summary: Get a list of wikis on a CreateWiki wikifarm.
compass-button-reset:
Label for the button that clears every search filter on Special:Compass.
{{Identical|Reset}}
compass-card-established:
Shown on a wiki card on Special:Compass. Parameters:
* $1 - the date the wiki was created
compass-card-more: Label of the accordion on a wiki card that expands to show the extended description.
compass-filter-search: Label for the free text search field on Special:Compass.
compass-filter-search-placeholder: Placeholder text for the free text search field on Special:Compass.
compass-header-info: Information text under legend header explaining what users can refine their search by.
compass-highlights-heading: Heading shown above the pinned wiki cards on Special:Compass.
compass-label-description-help: Help text for the short description field in ManageWiki.
compass-label-extended-description: Label for the extended description field in ManageWiki.
compass-label-extended-description-help: Help text for the extended description field in ManageWiki.
compass-label-highlighted: Text of the chip shown on pinned wiki cards on Special:Compass.
compass-label-visible: Label for the ManageWiki checkbox that controls whether a wiki is listed on Special:Compass.
compass-label-visible-help: Help text for the visibility checkbox in ManageWiki.
compass-pagination-next: Label for the link to the next page of results on Special:Compass.
compass-pagination-previous: Label for the link to the previous page of results on Special:Compass.
compass-results-count:
Summary of the results currently shown on Special:Compass. Parameters:
* $1 - the number of the first result shown
* $2 - the number of the last result shown
* $3 - the total number of results
compass-results-empty: Shown on Special:Compass when no wiki matches the selected filters.
compass-results-heading: Heading shown above the paginated list of wikis on Special:Compass.
compasscurate-add-button: Label for the button that adds a wiki to the highlights.
compasscurate-add-heading: Heading of the form used to add a wiki to the highlights.
compasscurate-add-help: Help text for the database name field on Special:CompassCurate.
compasscurate-add-label: Label for the database name field on Special:CompassCurate.
compasscurate-current-heading: Heading of the list of currently highlighted wikis.
compasscurate-empty: Shown on Special:CompassCurate when no wiki is highlighted.
compasscurate-error-already:
Error shown when the given wiki is already highlighted. Parameters:
* $1 - the database name of the wiki
compasscurate-error-full:
Error shown when the configured maximum number of highlighted wikis is reached. Parameters:
* $1 - the maximum number of highlighted wikis
compasscurate-error-nowiki:
Error shown when the given database name does not exist. Parameters:
* $1 - the database name that was entered
compasscurate-header-order:
Column header for the sort order of a highlighted wiki.
{{Identical|Order}}
compasscurate-header-remove:
Column header for the remove checkbox.
{{Identical|Remove}}
compasscurate-header-wiki:
Column header for the wiki name.
{{Identical|Wiki}}
compasscurate-hidden: Chip shown on Special:CompassCurate next to a highlighted wiki that has opted out of being listed.
compasscurate-save:
Label for the button that saves the highlight order and removals.
{{Identical|Save changes}}
compasscurate-success-added:
Confirmation shown after a wiki was highlighted. Parameters:
* $1 - the database name of the wiki
compasscurate-success-saved: Confirmation shown after the highlights were saved.
randomwiki-header: Information text under legend header informing users what the page does.
randomwiki-parameters: Legend header in Special:RandomWiki asking users to insert parameters for their search.
